analysis: The method `handleMouseMoveOverNewCard` is designed to handle a mouse move event over a new card in a game. The method first checks if the `topPane` is an instance of `GamePane` and if the `data.getGameId()` is not null and does not match the `GamePane`'s game ID, in which case, it returns early. Then, it hides a tooltip popup and cancels hiding an enlarged card. It determines the `parentComponent` as the root of `cardPanel` or, if that is null, as the desktop from `MageFrame`. The `getLocationOnScreen` method is called on `parentComponent` to get its location on the screen. The method then sets the `data.getLocationOnScreen()` if it is null, and calls several `ArrowUtil` methods to draw arrows for various game elements. Finally, it starts a card hint popup. The `getLocationOnScreen` method can throw an `IllegalComponentStateException` if the component is not showing on the screen. In the given code, there is no explicit check to ensure that `parentComponent` is showing on the screen before calling `getLocationOnScreen`.

answer.IllegalComponentStateException: The throwing condition is NOT avoided. The `parentComponent` is checked for null, but there is no check to ensure it is showing on the screen before calling `getLocationOnScreen`.

remark: The `IllegalComponentStateException` will be thrown if `parentComponent` is not showing on the screen. This can happen if `parentComponent` is not visible or if it is not part of the display hierarchy. The code does not perform any check to ensure that `parentComponent` is actually showing, so this exception is not avoided.
